name: Sequencing QC overview
description: Overview of a sequencing table: reads per sample (stacked by run when a run_id column exists), read quality and Q30 per run, a per-sample QC table with low-yield flags and a per-run table. Panels that need columns the table does not have are skipped and listed in the run notes.

inputs.label: Sequencing table
inputs.description: One row per sample per sequencing run, such as the built-in Sequencing dataset. Uses read_count_1, read_count_2, avg_quality_1, avg_quality_2, q30_score, run_id, platform, instrument and sample_id when present.

low_read_threshold.title: Low-yield threshold (reads)
low_read_threshold.description: Samples with fewer total reads than this are flagged as low yield.

outputs.name: reads_per_sample
outputs.description: Total reads per sample, stacked by run when run_id is present.

outputs.name: quality_by_run
outputs.description: Average read quality per run (box plots) and Q30 per run.

outputs.name: qc_table
outputs.description: Per-sample read totals, quality means, runs and low-yield flags.

outputs.name: runs
outputs.description: Per-run platform, sample count, Q30 and read totals.

citation: Built with pandas (McKinney 2010; The pandas development team, https://pandas.pydata.org), NumPy (Harris et al. 2020, https://numpy.org) and Plotly (Plotly Technologies Inc., https://plotly.com/python/). See README.md for details.
